top_signals.title: Iran defiant on strait as Trump tells Americans to accept high gas prices
top_signals.summary: Progress toward peace talks and oil tanker traffic through the strategic Strait of Hormuz waterway remain halted.

top_signals.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
top_signals.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: Nintendo has been grappling with rising memory prices which forced the company to raise prices of its Switch 2 console which went on sale just over a year ago.
